# @apps-in-toss/web-framework

Web SDK for building [Apps in Toss](https://toss.im/apps-in-toss) mini-apps that run inside the Toss app WebView.

APIs that talk to the native bridge only work in the [Toss](https://toss.im/) app ([App Store](https://apps.apple.com/kr/app/%ED%86%A0%EC%8A%A4/id839333328) · [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=viva.republica.toss)). A standalone browser has no bridge, so those calls won't work there.

## Install

```bash
# yarn
yarn add @apps-in-toss/web-framework

# npm
npm install @apps-in-toss/web-framework

# pnpm
pnpm add @apps-in-toss/web-framework
```
